map.劳动经济补偿金（N+1）测算 使用指南: Labor economic compensation (N+1) calculator user guide
map.劳动经济补偿金（N+1）测算工具依据工作年限与月工资估算解除劳动关系的经济补偿与: The labor economic compensation (N+1) calculator estimates economic compensation and notice pay from years of service and monthly wage, suitable for HR accounting, layoff plans and rights-protection reference.
map.用人单位无过失性辞退（医疗期满、不胜任、客观情况重大变化）且未提前 30 日通知: Employer no-fault dismissal (medical-period end, incompetence, major change of circumstances) without 30 days' notice: calculate N+1 compensation.
map.N 按工作年限计算，满半年不满 1 年按 1 年，不满半年按 0.5 年。: N is counted by years of service; a half year to less than 1 year counts as 1 year, less than half a year counts as 0.5 year.
map.月工资超当地社平工资 3 倍的，按 3 倍封顶且年限最高 12 年。: Monthly wage above 3x the local social average is capped, and years are capped at 12.
map.工作 6 年、月薪 1 万、未提前通知: 6 years service, monthly wage 10,000, no prior notice
map.：N = 6 个月，经济补偿 = 10000 × 6 = 60,000 元；代通: : N = 6 months, economic compensation = 10000 x 6 = 60,000 yuan; notice pay (+1) = 10,000 yuan; N+1 total 70,000 yuan.
map.：工作 15 年、月薪 5 万（超社平 3 倍），N 封顶 12 年、基数封顶社: : 15 years service, monthly wage 50,000 (above 3x social average), N capped at 12 years, base capped at 3x social average (e.g. 35,000): economic compensation = 35000 x 12 = 420,000 yuan.
map.「+1」是用人单位未提前 30 日书面通知解除时额外支付的一个月工资（代通知金）: The "+1" is an extra one-month wage (notice pay) paid by the employer when terminating without 30 days' prior written notice; it is a different nature from economic compensation N.
map.限于《劳动合同法》第 40 条三种无过失性辞退且未提前通知；违法解除适用 2N: Limited to the three no-fault dismissals under Article 40 of the Labor Contract Law without prior notice; wrongful termination applies 2N damages; voluntary resignation generally has no compensation.
